instruction: A candid studio photograph captured in a medium shot at eye-level against a plain white background. On the left, the blonde woman in the beige long-sleeve top (R1) is seen in profile facing right, reaching her arms forward. On the right, the brunette woman in the grey-brown long-sleeve top (R2) is also in profile facing left, reaching her arms out. The two women face each other, preparing to embrace. The scene is illuminated by bright, even studio lighting, creating a clean and minimalist aesthetic.
